mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rate levels (FEDFUNDS) compress discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as the rate approaches the zero lower bound.
failure_condition: Rank IC of FEDFUNDS on 20d returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20d returns in low-FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained federal funds rate above 4.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rising unemployment (UNRATE > previous month) and slowing employment growth (PAYEMS growth rate < 0.5%) indicate labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS growth rate < 0.5%
failure_condition: The interaction signal (UNRATE rise > 0.3pp and PAYEMS growth < 0.5%) fails to produce negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 YoY growth > 2.5%) indicates overbought equity markets, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days as growth momentum peaks.
failure_condition: The signal (GDPC1 YoY growth > 2.5%) fails to produce negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals persistent labor market slack, increasing equity risk premiums and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO growth > 1.0%) combined with weak housing starts (HOUST < 1800) indicates supply-demand imbalance, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (INDPRO growth > 1.0% and HOUST < 1800) fails to produce negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher unemployment rate levels (UNRATE) compress equity risk premiums through reduced consumer spending, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days as a continuous signal.
failure_condition: Rank IC of UNRATE on 5d returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5d returns in high-UNRATE periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1700 units indicate weak residential demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days as a threshold signal.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST < 1700 over any 3-year rolling window.
